_comment: Single source of truth for per-model limits. Consumed by generate-openclaw-config.py, Dockerfile defaults, and (future) routing layer. Update here, regenerate downstream artifacts.

moonshotai/kimi-k2.5.reasoningSafeReason: K2.5 emits tool calls in a format that the openclaw harness can't round-trip when reasoning=true; agent loops on empty toolUse stops. See project_chad_cron_pattern memory.
moonshotai/kimi-k2.5._deprecated: Removed from NVIDIA Endpoints catalog 2026-04-29 (returns 410 GONE on inference). Upstream NemoClaw PR #2735 dropped it from CLOUD_MODEL_OPTIONS. Entry retained for historical task-profiles inheritance comments.

nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b._note: Default cloud model since 2026-04-30 (replacing the deprecated Kimi K2.5). MoE: ~120B total / ~12B active. Hosted on integrate.api.nvidia.com via the NVIDIA_API_KEY.

google/gemma-3-4b._note: Local fallback, Jetson-class. Ceiling for cron tasks running offline.

claude-opus-4-7._note: Premium endpoint. Hits Anthropic Messages API directly. Routed via chad-premium-client; access gated by chad-auth-context (dashboard senderId, terminal token, tantodefi@proton.me sender, or @supachad mention).

claude-sonnet-4-6._note: Default premium model for /premium and chad-premium. Cheaper than Opus, still frontier-grade reasoning.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001._note: Used by chad-premium-client --probe for cheap connectivity check.
